paragraphs.text: Gas hydrate (GH) occurs in marine sediment at site CUG-3. Pore-water salinity is 3.5 wt% NaCl equivalent.
Dissociation pressure of GH increases by 0.9 MPa when salinity rises from 0 to 3.5 wt% at 4 °C.
Permeability of the sandy layer is one order of magnitude higher than that of the clay at site CUG-3.

paragraphs.text: Gas hydrate (GH) was synthesized in a sediment sample (S2) at 4 °C. Salinity was set to 3.5 wt%.
Dissociation pressure of the lab hydrate increases by 0.6 MPa between 0 and 3.5 wt% salinity at 4 °C.
Permeability of the sandy layer exceeds that of the clay by a factor of 8 in sample S2.
